notes:
Inbound SMB self-serve signup; started using hosted API with free credits (trial key created 2026-02-20). User base is North America HQ but ~30% traffic from EU customers via marketing campaign. Initial reports via support: 'responses feel slow' and client SDK shows intermittent timeouts.

Discovery call 2026-03-05 (Alicia + Ravi + technical lead Sara H.):
- Sara: seeing 700-1200ms p95 for short-chat generation in eu-west-1 when users are in EU; mobile clients hit socket timeout ~15s on longer prompts.
- They currently call model redwood-compact-v1 with default region (us-east-1) in some environments, eu-west-1 in others. No explicit connection pooling.
- Business: small paid plan after trial; very cost-sensitive. Wants responsive chat for customer support and quick doc lookup.

Observed from their logs (shared):
- median latencies ~120ms (good) but p95/p99 spikes up to 1.2s on EU traffic, correlated with cross-region routing and occasional cold-starts.
- Client SDK timeout is 15s; server-side webhook retries causing extra perceived latency on clients.

Recommended tuning & immediate actions (shared in call):
- Region choice: recommend pinning EU users to eu-west-1 or eu-central-1 for lower network RTT; avoid cross-region fallback for latency-sensitive routes.
- Timeouts: increase frontend socket timeout to 30s for streaming flows; set shorter application-level retries to avoid double-sends.
- Prompt guidance: trim system prompt and remove verbose few-shot examples when not needed; move longer context to embeddings + retrieval to limit token lengths (reduces per-token compute and latency).
- Streaming: enable streaming responses for chat UI to improve perceived latency (first-token latency matters more than full completion).
- Model variant: try redwood-compact-v1-rt or a lower-latency flavor for conversational short-turns; fallback to higher-quality model for expensive rerank/long-generation only.
- Batching & rate limits: small continuous batching on server side can increase throughput without hurting p50; avoid large burst windows.
- Monitoring: add per-region p95, cold-start alerts, and token-cost per route to Dashboard.

POC plan agreed: 1-week perf POC (Ravi to configure routes):
- Day 1: replicate production traffic shape in us-west-2 + eu-west-1 (10k synthetic requests, mixed prompt lengths).
- Day 2-3: test region pinning + streaming enabled, compare p50/p95/p99.
- Day 4: test SDK timeout changes (15s -> 30s) and mobile reconnection behavior.
- Day 5: finalize recommended config and handoff docs.

Sales/contract notes:
- Customer is price-sensitive; a small committed monthly plan ($5k-$15k ARR) expected if perf SLAs met.
- Legal asked for SOC2 doc before moving to paid plan; engineering wants clear perf improvements first.

Next steps / owner action items:
- Ravi: provision EU & US test routes, share perf baseline by 2026-03-15.
- Alicia: send SOC2 snapshot + security FAQ link (drive:/security/soc2-snapshot.pdf).
- Sara (customer): provide mobile SDK logs and representative prompt set by 2026-03-14.
